spans.s:
mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Undone, neglected, incomplete.
n. (-तं)
Any act unperformed.
E.
अ neg. कृत done.

mfn. (-ज्ञः-ज्ञा-ज्ञं)
Ungrateful.
E.
अ neg. कृतज्ञ grateful.

f. (-ता)
Ingratitude.
E.
ता added to अकृतज्ञ.

n. (-त्वं)
Ingratitude.
E.
त्व added to अकृतज्ञ.

mfn. (-त्मा-त्मा-त्म)
Not identified or made one with oneself, especially in a spiritual sense, not one with spirit, or God.
E.
अकृत unmade, आत्मन् self.

n. (-त्वं)
Awkwardness, clumsiness, unfitness.
E.
अकृतिन् and त्व aff.

mfn. (-ती-तिनी-ति)
Awkward, stupid, incapable of or unfit for doing any thing.
E.
अ neg. कृ to do, इन् aff. and त augment.

mfn. (-मः-मा-मं)
Natural, inartificial, not made.
E.
अ. neg. कृतिम artificial.

mfn. (-पः-पा-पं)
Unmerciful, unkind.
E.
अ neg. कृपा mercy.

mfn. (-णः-णा-णं)
Liberal, not miserly.
E.
अ neg. कृपण miserly.

mfn. (-शः-शा-शं)
1 Full, entire.
2 Strong, fierce.
E.
अ neg. कृश little.

mfn. (-र्म्मा-र्म्मा-र्म्म)
Innocent.
E.
अ neg. and कृष्णकर्म्मन् guilty.

f. (-तिः)
1 Form, figure.
2 The body.
3 Tribe, species.
4 A metre: a stanza of four lines, with twenty-two syllables to each line.
E.
आङ् before कृ to make or do, क्तिन् aff.

mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं)
1 Pulled, drawn.
2 Attracted.
E.
आङ् before कृष to drag, क्त aff.

mfn. (-णः-णा-णं)
Drawing, attracting.
E.
आकृष to draw, शानच् aff.

mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्)
1 Pulling, dragging, pulling up or out.
2 Pulling to, attracting.
3 Charming, fascinating.
E.
आकृष्ट and मतुप् aff.

f. (-ष्टिः)
1 Pulling, dragging.
2 Drawing, attraction.
E.
आङ् before कृष to drag, affix क्तिन्.
